components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button (Reload Sensors). Full-width, Warm Stone background.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15"></path></svg> Reload Sensors</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 0; background: #57534e; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(87, 83, 78, 0.3); transition: transform 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action (Clear). Gray background, next to primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 12px 16px; background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Filter Button
components.description: Map filter toggle (All / Free / Taken). Segmented control style.
components.css: .ds-filter-btn { flex: 1; padding: 10px 0; background: #f3f4f6; color: #4b5563; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-filter-btn:hover { background: #e5e7eb; } .ds-filter-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-filter-btn.active { background: #1f2937; color: #fff; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Numerical stat display (Total, Free, Taken, Visible). 4-column grid item.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #f9fafb; border: 1px solid #f3f4f6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-stat-number { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #1f2937; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-stat-card.free { background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #d1fae5; } .ds-stat-card.free .ds-stat-number { color: #10b981; } .ds-stat-card.free .ds-stat-label { color: #34D399; } .ds-stat-card.occupied { background: #fef2f2; border-color: #fecaca; } .ds-stat-card.occupied .ds-stat-number { color: #ef4444; } .ds-stat-card.occupied .ds-stat-label { color: #F87171; } .ds-stat-card.visible { background: #f5f5f4; border-color: #e7e5e4; } .ds-stat-card.visible .ds-stat-number { color: #57534e; } .ds-stat-card.visible .ds-stat-label { color: #78716c; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Address search bar. Full-width pill, glass background, stone focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-search-input" type="text" placeholder="Search address in Melbourne...">
components.css: .ds-search-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 20px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); color: #1f2937; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-search-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #57534e, 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); }

components.name: Staleness Badge
components.description: Data age indicator. Green/amber/red dot with label.
components.css: .ds-staleness-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-staleness-badge.fresh { background: #ecfdf5; color: #57534e; } .ds-staleness-badge.fresh .ds-dot { background: #10b981; } .ds-staleness-badge.stale { background: #fffbeb; color: #92400e; } .ds-staleness-badge.stale .ds-dot { background: #f59e0b; animation: ds-pulse 1.5s infinite; } .ds-staleness-badge.old { background: #fef2f2; color: #991b1b; } .ds-staleness-badge.old .ds-dot { background: #ef4444; animation: ds-pulse 1s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

components.name: Error Banner
components.description: Transient error/warning notification with optional retry action.
components.html: Error message
components.css: .ds-error-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-error-banner.error { background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; color: #991b1b; } .ds-error-banner.warn { background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; color: #92400e; } .ds-retry-btn { margin-left: auto; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border: none; color: #fff; } .ds-error-banner.error .ds-retry-btn { background: #dc2626; } .ds-error-banner.warn .ds-retry-btn { background: #d97706; } .ds-retry-btn:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

narrative.overview:
A glassmorphism utility layer that floats over live map data. The interface is translucent — panels blur the map behind them, creating depth without occlusion. Nothing is hidden; the data is always visible, always current. The design language is calm, functional, and distinctly Melbourne: the primary action color is Warm Stone, a neutral that recedes from the map while maintaining clear affordances.

The system is built for stressed commuters making fast decisions. Every element earns its pixel: status colors carry meaning (green = free, red = occupied), progressive disclosure hides complexity until needed, and the bottom sheet pattern keeps primary actions within thumb reach.
keyCharacteristics: Glassmorphism panels with backdrop-filter blur over live map
Status-driven color coding: green = free, red = occupied, gray = unknown
Warm Stone (#57534e) as the neutral primary accent — recedes from the map
Bottom sheet with swipe gesture for mobile-first interaction
Progressive disclosure: overview → detail, always one view at a time
Real-time staleness awareness via color-coded badge

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and gray are reserved exclusively for parking bay status on the map. They are never used for buttons, text emphasis, or decorative purposes.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: All input text is 16px minimum. iOS Safari auto-zooms focused inputs under 16px, breaking form layouts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only for floating glass panels and map markers.

rules.name: The No-Sharp-Corners Rule
rules.body: Every container, button, badge, and card has a minimum 4px radius.

dos: Do use status colors (green/red/gray) exclusively for parking bay status on the map.
Do keep the glass panels translucent — the map should always be partially visible behind UI.
Do use the bottom sheet pattern for mobile-primary interactions.
Do force 16px font-size on all inputs to prevent iOS auto-zoom.
Do show data staleness via the badge — users must know how old the data is.
Do use active:scale-95 for touch feedback on buttons.
donts: Don't use green, red, or gray for anything other than parking status.
Don't add opaque backgrounds to floating panels — transparency is core to the system.
Don't use sharp corners on any element (minimum 4px radius).
Don't auto-refresh data — the user controls refresh via the Reload button.
Don't show more than one view in the bottom sheet at a time (overview OR detail, never both).
Don't add decorative shadows to flat elements — shadows are reserved for floating glass panels.
